item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Advances Skills to Support Smart Industries
item.description: The Selangor government is modernising its TVET programmes to equip a future-ready workforce with digital, AI, automation and smart manufacturing skills, driving inclusive industrial growth aligned with Industry 5.0 and national aspirations.

item.title: Indonesia Strengthens AI and Semiconductor Ties with India
item.description: Indonesia is actively and strategically partnering with India to advance AI and semiconductor development while promoting inclusive technology for social, economic and digital growth across the country.

item.title: Australia: NSW to Boost Clean Technology and Regional Jobs
item.description: The NSW Government has committed AU$52 million to accelerate renewable manufacturing, create and support regional jobs and advance innovative low-carbon technologies across agriculture, transport and energy systems.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Transformation Reshapes Handicraft Exports
item.description: Vietnam’s handicraft sector is embracing digital transformation to enhance traceability, expand e-commerce reach and strengthen its position in premium global markets amid shifting supply chains and sustainability demands.

item.title: Vietnam: AI Education for a Digital, People-Centred Future
item.description: Vietnam is piloting a purpose-driven AI education framework to equip students with essential digital skills, ethical understanding, and practical hands-on learning experience for a responsible, people-centred future.

item.title: Malaysia: Tech-Driven Diplomacy in 2026–2030 Strategic Plan
item.description: Malaysia’s 2026–2030 strategic plan integrates technology, innovation, and digital transformation into diplomacy, strengthening international partnerships, regional collaboration and science-driven development.

item.title: The Philippines: Ramping Up Local and Global Digital Services
item.description: The Philippines is expanding digital services for citizens locally through the QCitizen ID and internationally by protecting overseas Filipino workers from online fraud and enhancing secure digital access anywhere in the world.

item.title: Australia: Quantum Computing for Remote Grid Optimisation
item.description: Flinders University has secured AU$1.45 million in federal funding to develop a quantum computing demonstrator aimed at optimising remote, distributed, hybrid, microgrid and renewable energy systems efficiently and reliably.

item.title: India Expands Digital Health Impact Domestically and Globally
item.description: India advances its digital health and telemedicine ecosystem through innovation, international collaboration and strategic partnerships, strengthening domestic care and supporting global healthcare development.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Its Role in the Global Quantum Value Chain
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its quantum ecosystem by scaling advanced hardware manufacturing capabilities, deepening global collaborations and advancing research translation under its National Quantum Strategy.
